problems.title: The wrong skill runs—or none runs
problems.description: Make skills discoverable and distinguish neighboring responsibilities.
problems.practices: Trigger descriptions, routing tests, discovery and indexing.

problems.title: The agent ignores or reinterprets instructions
problems.description: Write instructions that survive ambiguity, shortcuts and pressure.
problems.practices: Mandatory constraints, rationale, guardrails and anti-rationalization.

problems.title: Instructions consume too much context
problems.description: Keep entrypoints small and load detailed guidance only when needed.
problems.practices: Progressive disclosure, pruning and conditional references.

problems.title: Skills and agents have overlapping responsibilities
problems.description: Give each procedure and responsibility one clear owner.
problems.practices: Composition, bounded roles, shared procedures and adapters.

problems.title: The agent lacks required inputs or context
problems.description: Specify inputs, configuration, evidence and resource resolution.
problems.practices: Runtime values, source access, assumptions and repository context.

problems.title: Delegated work loses scope or results
problems.description: Define bounded assignments and verifiable handoff contracts.
problems.practices: Worker scope, isolation, aggregation and coordination.

problems.title: Outputs are inconsistent or unusable
problems.description: Define what the consumer receives and who owns its format.
problems.practices: Templates, schemas, placeholders and evidence-backed reports.

problems.title: The agent stops before work is complete
problems.description: Define observable completion and account for every obligation.
problems.practices: Completion criteria, verification evidence and completeness sweeps.

problems.title: The agent repeats mistakes or loses progress
problems.description: Preserve useful lessons and resume from verified state.
problems.practices: Gotchas, memory, ledgers and resume notes.

problems.title: I cannot tell whether my guidance works
problems.description: Evaluate observable behavior and improve guidance from evidence.
problems.practices: Routing fixtures, tool traces, pressure tests and controlled comparisons.
